definitions.gloss: control; regulation (by an authority); air-traffic control
definitions.explanation: Control exercised by an authority over traffic, information, or other activity, especially the direction of aircraft by air-traffic controllers. Also used of wartime or official restrictions, as in a news blackout.

examples.japanese: ⟦{管制塔|かんせいとう}→管制塔：15837_kanseitou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Instructions came from the control tower.

examples.japanese: {航空|こうくう}{管制|かんせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧。
examples.english: Air-traffic control is a job with heavy responsibility.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧{管制|かんせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{敷|し}かれ→敷く：00366_shiku⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わらなかった→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧。
examples.english: During the war a news blackout was imposed, and the true information did not reach the public.

notes:
Mostly met in compounds. As a verb, {管制|かんせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is rare outside technical writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {航空|こうくう}{管制|かんせい}: air-traffic control
- ⟦{管制塔|かんせいとう}→管制塔：15837_kanseitou⟧: control tower
- {管制官|かんせいかん}: air-traffic controller
- ⟦{報道|ほうどう}→報道：04438_houdou⟧{管制|かんせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to impose a news blackout
- ⟦{灯火|とうか}→灯火：22543_touka⟧{管制|かんせい}: wartime blackout of lights

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: regulation — rules restricting activity, not moment-to-moment direction
- ⟦{統制|とうせい}→統制：21836_tousei⟧: control, regulation — tight control of an economy or society
- ⟦{完成|かんせい}→完成：01550_kansei⟧: completion — same reading, unrelated
